$comment: Applied to foods and meals. `excludes` lists foodClasses ids (declared below) that must NOT be present for the tag to hold. Every food in catalog/ingredients.json carries `foodClasses`, so the filter is computed rather than hand-typed -- a meal cannot be mislabelled vegan while containing butter. Allergens are tracked separately in allergens.json: a food class is a dietary choice, an allergen is a safety declaration.

foodClasses.label: Pork
foodClasses.note: A subset of meat; broken out for halal and kosher.

foodClasses.label: Dairy
foodClasses.note: Anything from milk, including whey and casein.

foodClasses.label: Eggs
foodClasses.note: Whole egg or any egg fraction.

foodClasses.label: Honey
foodClasses.note: Excluded by vegan, not by vegetarian.

foodClasses.label: Legumes
foodClasses.note: Beans, lentils, peas, soy and peanuts.

foodClasses.label: Peanuts
foodClasses.note: Botanically a legume; carried as both.

items.label: High protein
items.rule: protein at or above 30% of energy
